metadata.topic: BUILD ZOOM CONTACT CENTER APP · ANTHROPIC SKILL
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: does 'build a Zoom contact center app' mean Claude hands you a talking AI agent, or does it build the integration around Zoom's existing Contact Center platform? Lands the carry-out that build-zoom-contact-center-app makes Claude build the app — engagement context, state handling, campaigns, callbacks, version-drift fixes — not a conversational agent that talks to callers.

beats.narration_text: For this skill, the scope is five things: app, web, or native integrations; engagement context and state handling; campaigns; callbacks; and version-drift troubleshooting. Each sits inside Zoom's existing Contact Center platform — Claude fits code around it, it doesn't replace it. Ask for something outside those five and there's no mode that covers it.
